_meta.purpose: Smallest safe identity override for a current-season head-coach change (firing / interim promotion) that games.csv does not yet reflect. Applied ONLY from the effective (season, week) forward; never rewrites earlier weeks. Once games.csv confirms the assignment, canonical history remains the source of truth and the entry can be removed. Do NOT enumerate all 32 coaches here.
notes: ANALYSIS CONTEXT ONLY — not an input to Sides/Totals model math.
An override coach carries the league-average prior (rating 50) with an empty NFL-HC record until games.csv provides real history.
